//: Scoped typecheck for the UAT governance pages.
`npm run typecheck` in this repository compiles ZERO files and always exits 0, so it
proves nothing. `tsc -p tsconfig.app.json` does compile the app, but it also pulls in
src/__tests__/**, which has no vitest globals configured and produces hundreds of
pre-existing 'Cannot find name describe' errors that bury any real one.
This config checks the four UAT pages plus whatever they import (tsc follows imports),
which is the part a change to them can actually break.
It does NOT replace the full frontend typecheck in CI — it is the fast local gate.
Same pattern as tsconfig.vendor-check.json and its siblings.
